parts:
I seem to find a lot of these!

If I run


with(joks, qplot(days, grass_1, geom = c('point','smooth'),
main = 'Smooth lines of grass') + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(188, 371, 554, 737),
labels = c("Jan", "July", "Jan", "July", "Jan"),
colour = Patient_Name))


I get no errors, but the dots are all one color.


But if I run:

plot(joks$days, joks$grass_1, col = joks$Patient_Name)

the dots are different colors.

I am tempted to just go with the latter, and adjust the x-axis and
add a smooth, but I want to learn ggplot2.


Should I make up a replicable example, or is the solvable as is?

thanks

messages.subject: Re: Yet another question/problem
parts: On 2009-May-07  , at 14:15 , Peter Flom wrote:

>> qplot(days, grass_1, data= joks, geom = c('point','smooth'), colour =
>> Patient_Name, main = 'Smooth lines of grass') +
>> scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(188, 371, 554, 737), labels = c("Jan",
>> "July", "Jan", "July", "Jan"))
>
> This gives an error
>
> Error in predLoess(object$y, object$x, newx, object$s, object
> $weights, :
> NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 5)
>
> But I think I now understand the error - just not how to solve it.
> I *think*
> it's trying to fit a separate smooth to each patient name.

It does indeed: since you split them by colour, it considers it
different data groups (see plot on p31 of the ggplot book and the
grouping section).

In that case you need to switch to the ggplot construct and have some
explicit geom calls with independent aes. Something along the lines of:

ggplot(joks) + geom_point(aes(x=days, y=grass_1, colour=Patient_Name))
+ geom_smooth(aes(x=days, y=grass_1)) +

scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(188, 371, 554, 737), labels =
c("Jan","July", "Jan", "July", "Jan"))

But indeed a minimal example, with data, would help.


NB: I spelled the aes calls completely for each geom for clarity but
you can keep the common ones in gggplot:

ggplot(joks, ares(x=days, y=grass_1)) +
geom_point(aes(colour=Patient_Name)) + geom_smooth() +

scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(188, 371, 554, 737), labels =
c("Jan","July", "Jan", "July", "Jan"))

JiHO
